title: Query Planning
description: Read query plans and understand node types.

data.text: PostgreSQL optimizes queries into plans. Read plans with EXPLAIN.

data.title: Explain
data.code:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT u.id, COUNT(o.id)
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC
LIMIT 100;

data.title: Exercise: Read Plan
data.description: Read explain plan and identify sequential scans.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Look for seq scans on large tables.
